business_summary: Donnelley Financial Solutions, Inc. provides compliance and regulatory software and services in the United States, Asia, Europe, Canada, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Capital Markets  Software Solutions (CM-SS); Capital Markets  Compliance and Communications Management (CM-CCM); Investment Companies  Software Solutions (IC-SS); and Investment Companies  Compliance and Communications Management (IC-CCM). The CM-SS segment provides Venue and ActiveDisclosure solutions to public and private companies to manage public and private transactional and compliance processes; collaborate; and tag, validate, and file SEC documents. The CM-CCM segment offers tech-enabled services and print and distribution solutions to public and private companies for deal solutions and SEC compliance requirements. The IC-SS segment provides clients with the Arc Suite platform that contains a comprehensive suite of cloud-based solutions, including ArcDigital, ArcReporting, ArcPro, and ArcRegulatory, as well as services that enable storage and management of compliance and regulatory information in a self-service and central repository for accessing, assembling, editing, translating, rendering, and submitting documents to regulators and investors. The IC-CCM segment offers tech-enabled solutions for creating, filing and distributing regulatory communications, and solutions for investor communications, as well as iXBRL-formatted filings pursuant for Investment Company Act through the SEC's EDGAR system. This segment provides turnkey proxy services, including discovery, planning and implementation, print and mail management, solicitation, tabulation services, stockholder meeting review, and expert support. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.
business_summary_ko: Donnelley Financial Solutions, Inc.는 미국, 아시아, 유럽, 캐나다 및 국제적으로 규정 준수 및 규제 소프트웨어와 서비스를 제공합니다. 그것은 4개의 부문을 통해 운영됩니다: 자본 시장 소프트웨어 솔루션(CM-SS); 자본 시장 규정 준수 및 커뮤니케이션 관리(CM-CCM); 투자 회사 소프트웨어 솔루션(IC-SS); 및 투자 회사 규정 준수 및 커뮤니케이션 관리(IC-CCM). CM-SS 부문은 공공 및 민간 기업에 Venue 및 ActiveDisclosure 솔루션을 제공하여 공공 및 민간 거래 및 규정 준수 프로세스를 관리합니다. 협력하다; SEC 문서에 태그를 지정하고, 검증하고, 파일링합니다. CM-CCM 부문은 거래 솔루션 및 SEC 규정 준수 요구 사항을 충족하기 위해 공공 및 민간 기업에 기술 지원 서비스와 인쇄 및 배포 솔루션을 제공합니다. IC-SS 부문은 고객에게 ArcDigital, ArcReporting, ArcPro 및 ArcRegulatory를 포함한 포괄적인 클라우드 기반 솔루션 제품군과 액세스, 조립, 편집, 번역을 위한 셀프 서비스 및 중앙 저장소에서 규정 준수 및 규제 정보를 저장하고 관리할 수 있는 서비스를 포함하는 Arc Suite 플랫폼을 제공합니다.
